definitions.explanation: A brief summary of the main points or plot of a story, book, movie, or similar work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗筋|あらすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the plot summary of the movie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{裏表紙|うらびょうし}→裏表紙：28412_urabyoushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{粗筋|あらすじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The synopsis is written on the back cover of the book.

examples.japanese: {粗筋|あらすじ}⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}さ→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: You can't understand how interesting it is just by reading the synopsis.

notes:
USAGE: {粗筋|あらすじ} is commonly used for summarizing stories, novels, films, and dramas. It focuses on the main plot without detailed analysis.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {粗筋|あらすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧ (to explain the plot)
- {粗筋|あらすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (to read the synopsis)
- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粗筋|あらすじ} (story outline)

WRITING VARIATIONS: Can also be written as {荒筋|あらすじ}.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{要約|ようやく}→要約：14128_youyaku⟧ - summary (more general)
- ⟦{概要|がいよう}→概要：06747_gaiyou⟧ - outline, overview
- ⟦{要旨|ようし}→要旨：04087_youshi⟧ - gist, main point
